hostDeathDuringSpeech.title: Host disconnect during speech (Host process killed; F04 job closes; worker and its audio die)
hostDeathDuringSpeech.note: Audible stop is the worker process ending with the Host's job (waveOut handle released by the OS). Process-exit time includes the poll interval.
